intro: Denver rewards visitors with mountain views, a walkable core and a booming food and beer scene. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: RTD light rail and commuter rail link downtown, suburbs and the airport.
RTD buses cost $2.75 cash with a 3-hour transfer; day passes about $5.50.
Taxis are metered; Uber and Lyft both work well in Denver.
A car is handy outside downtown; toll roads are cashless, so check rental billing.
Downtown is walkable; bikes and scooters are common in summer.
No ferry service; the city is landlocked.

red_rocks.name: Red Rocks Amphitheatre
red_rocks.price_text: Park entry free · concert tickets vary by show
red_rocks.hours: Park open daily roughly 05:00–23:00 · check on the day for event closures
red_rocks.tip: Come in the morning to walk the trails and see the venue empty. On show days the park closes early to visitors.

denver_art_museum.name: Denver Art Museum
denver_art_museum.price_text: Adult ticket roughly USD 20–25 · under 18 often free · check on the day
denver_art_museum.tip: The building itself is worth the visit. Book a timed ticket online to skip the line.

state_capitol.name: Colorado State Capitol
state_capitol.price_text: Free · dome tours free but limited
state_capitol.hours: Weekdays roughly 07:30–17:00 · dome tours on weekdays only
state_capitol.tip: Stand on the Mile High step on the west entrance. Dome tours are first come, first served.

mines.name: Colorado School of Mines
mines.price_text: Campus free · Geology Museum free, donations welcome
mines.hours: Geology Museum weekdays roughly 09:00–16:00 · check on the day
mines.tip: The campus is in Golden, about 25 minutes by car. The small geology museum has a great mineral collection.

coors.name: Coors Brewery
coors.price_text: Tour roughly USD 10–20 · check on the day
coors.hours: Tours usually Wed–Sun · book online in advance
coors.tip: Tours sell out. Book ahead and bring ID, since you must be 21 to sample.

elitch.name: Elitch Gardens
elitch.price_text: Day ticket roughly USD 50–70 · check on the day
elitch.hours: Seasonal · usually open daily in summer, weekends in spring and fall
elitch.tip: It is a seasonal park near downtown. Check the calendar before you go, as it closes in winter.

lakeside.name: Lakeside Amusement Park
lakeside.price_text: Ride tickets or wristband · prices vary, check on the day
lakeside.hours: Seasonal summer evenings mainly · check on the day
lakeside.tip: An old-fashioned park with a vintage feel. Go at dusk when the neon lights come on.

flea_market.name: Mile High Flea Market
flea_market.price_text: Small entry fee roughly USD 2–5 · check on the day
flea_market.hours: Usually Fri–Sun daytime · check on the day
flea_market.tip: Bring cash and comfortable shoes. It is big and mostly outdoors.

quiznos.name: Quiznos
quiznos.hours: Varies by branch · most open daily around lunch and dinner
quiznos.tip: The chain started in Denver. It is a quick, cheap lunch rather than a sight.

union_station.name: Denver Union Station
union_station.hours: Building open daily · shops and bars have their own hours
union_station.tip: Sit in the Great Hall with a coffee and watch the trains. It is the heart of LoDo.

larimer_square.name: Larimer Square
larimer_square.hours: Always open · shops and restaurants vary
larimer_square.tip: Denver's oldest block. Come in the evening when the string lights are on.

sixteenth_street.name: 16th Street Mall walk
sixteenth_street.tip: A long pedestrian street through downtown. Walk it end to end or take the free shuttle.

denver_central_market.name: Denver Central Market
denver_central_market.hours: Daily roughly 08:00–21:00 · check on the day
denver_central_market.tip: A food hall in RiNo with many small stalls. Good for a group where everyone wants something different.

rino_murals.name: RiNo street art walk
rino_murals.tip: Walk Larimer and Blake streets for big murals. Breweries nearby make a good stop.

city_park.name: City Park and Denver Zoo area
city_park.price_text: Park free · zoo and museum charge separately
city_park.tip: A big park with mountain views over the lake. Bring a picnic.

molly_brown.name: Molly Brown House Museum
molly_brown.price_text: Adult ticket roughly USD 15–20 · check on the day
molly_brown.hours: Closed some weekdays · check on the day
molly_brown.tip: The home of the 'unsinkable' Titanic survivor. Tours are guided and short.

coors_field.name: Coors Field baseball game
coors_field.price_text: Tickets roughly USD 15–60 depending on seat
coors_field.hours: Game days in season, usually April–October
coors_field.tip: Cheap seats in the upper deck have the best mountain view. Buy tickets online.

denver_botanic.name: Denver Botanic Gardens
denver_botanic.price_text: Adult ticket roughly USD 15–20 · check on the day
denver_botanic.tip: Quiet and green. Go early to avoid the heat in summer.

wings_over_rockies.name: Wings Over the Rockies Air & Space Museum
wings_over_rockies.price_text: Adult ticket roughly USD 15–20 · check on the day
wings_over_rockies.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
wings_over_rockies.tip: Good for families and plane fans. It is east of downtown, so plan transport.

cherry_creek.name: Cherry Creek North walk
cherry_creek.tip: A pleasant shopping and cafe district. Good for a slow afternoon.

great_divide.name: Great Divide Brewing Co.
great_divide.hours: Daily, usually afternoon into evening · check on the day
great_divide.tip: A classic Denver brewery taproom. Go on a weekday to avoid crowds.

denver_mint.name: Denver Mint tour
denver_mint.tip: Tours are free but slots fill fast. Book online weeks before your trip.

confluence_park.name: Confluence Park
confluence_park.tip: Where the city began. A short riverside walk links it to LoDo.

styles.blurb: Museums, street art and a gold-rush past.

stays.why: Historic core by Union Station. Walk to Coors Field, the river and most of downtown. Best first-timer base.
Central, close to the 16th Street Mall and light rail. Quieter at weekends when offices empty.
Cheaper, leafy streets near museums and Cheesman Park. Good cafés and nightlife on nearby Colfax.
Mural-covered warehouse district with breweries and food halls. Lively, a short ride from downtown.

food: Try a green chile dish: smothered burritos and breakfast burritos are a local staple. Ask about heat level.
Denver has many breweries and taprooms. RiNo and LoDo are the easiest clusters to walk between.
Food halls are handy for groups: look for one downtown or in RiNo and check current opening hours.
Rocky Mountain oysters and bison appear on menus; try them if you are curious.
High altitude can affect you: drink water, go easy on alcohol on day one, and eat a proper meal before a big hike.
more_time: Add a day in the mountains: Boulder or Golden are short drives or bus rides from Denver; check current schedules.
Swap a city afternoon for Red Rocks Park and Amphitheatre; check whether a show or event is on.
Museum lovers can spend a half day at the Denver Art Museum or the Denver Museum of Nature & Science.
